{{Top|leg|canon=Ship-scale disruptor}}
[[File:QV-3_Disruptor.png|thumb|right|250px|A disruptor cannon]]
A '''disruptor cannon''' was a large-sized [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] weapon. Disruptor cannons were larger than personal disruptors (such as [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifles]]) and were usually designed to be mounted on vehicles. Disruptor guns were most effective against armor plating but least effective against [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

Examples of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-mounted disruptor cannons in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] included [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]'s [[Fr13 Disruptor]], [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]]' [[QV-3 Disruptor]] and [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] [["Eradicator 1" Disruptor]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

[[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] was rumored to have installed disruptor cannons on [[RHTC-560 HT Drone]]s. He purportedly used the disruptor-armed drones against [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] for his own amusement.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
